```12:16:themes/hugo-scroll/assets/css/content.scss
}
```


And:


The `!important` flags are necessary because the theme's styles are also using `!important` in several places. This ensures our custom font settings take precedence.

This change will make both the headings and content in your grid items use the Oswald font consistently, with different weights to maintain visual hierarchy:
- Strong text (headings): Oswald 500 weight
- Regular content: Oswald 300 weight

_**User**_

Can we just overrwite roboto slab completely? I dont want it anywhere in my site

---

_**Assistant**_

Yes, we can override Roboto Slab completely throughout the site. Let's add these rules to your custom CSS to ensure Oswald is used everywhere:

```css:static/css/custom.css
// ... existing code ...

/* Override all Roboto Slab instances with Oswald */
body,
.blog-description,
.post-content,
.post-excerpt,
.post-meta,
p {
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
    font-weight: 300 !important;
}

/* Keep headings at a heavier weight */
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6,
.post h1, .post h2, .post h3, .post h4, .post h5, .post h6,
body .post-content h1, body .post-content h2, body .post-content h3,
body .post-content h4, body .post-content h5, body .post-content h6,
body #site-head h1, body #site-head h2, body #site-head h3,
body #site-head h4, body #site-head h5, body #site-head h6 {
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
}
```

This will:
1. Replace all instances of Roboto Slab with Oswald throughout the site
2. Use a lighter weight (300) for body text and paragraphs
3. Maintain a heavier weight (500) for headings
4. Override any other font families that might be specified in the theme

The `!important` flags are necessary to override the theme's default styles which also use `!important` declarations.

_**Assistant**_



Yes, let's modify the CSS to use Inter as the primary font and Oswald only for section headings:

```css:static/css/custom.css
// ... existing code ...

/* Set Inter as the default font for all body text */
body,
.blog-description,
.post-content,
.post-excerpt,
.post-meta,
p,
.item-content,
.grid-item {
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

/* Use Oswald only for main section headings */
h1, h2, h3,
.post h1, .post h2, .post h3,
body .post-content h1, body .post-content h2, body .post-content h3,
body #site-head h1, body #site-head h2, body #site-head h3 {
    font-family: 'Oswald', sans-serif !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
}

/* Grid items should use Inter */
.grid-item strong {
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
}
```

This will:
1. Use Inter as the default font for all body text and general content
2. Keep Oswald only for the main section headings (h1, h2, h3)
3. Use Inter for grid items, with a semi-bold weight for the strong text
4. Maintain consistent font weights throughout
